scenes.heading: scenefile 0.2
scenes.sub: Screenshots of your own app, a phone frame and ten themes.
scenes.say: Scenefile zero point two is out. Here is what is new.
The new capture command saves a picture of any web page, including an app running on your machine.
A screenshot scene can now draw the picture inside a phone.

scenes.heading: Also new
items: A video from a GitHub repository
scenes.say: There are also ten themes, a command that makes a video from a GitHub repository, and captions that follow the voice.
